"'''Squadron / Forest Defenders'''" is the sixth episode of the [[Young Jedi Adventures Season One|first season]] of the animated series ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Adventures]]''. It was released on [[Disney+]] on [[May 4]], [[2023]].<ref name="D23 May" />

==Official description==
''The Jedi are flight tested. The kids defend a forest.''
